messages.author: 743bbacc59f4b25f
messages.subject: matrix_normal.hpp
parts:
@Marcus: We were talking at the meeting today about the matrix_normal() function, which is apparently not exposed to the Stan language. Did you have a reason why you only wanted that to be used internally?

Ben

messages.author: 2a7f346506a3e9ff
messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] matrix_normal.hpp
parts:
I don't recall why I didn't want it exposed.  In fact if you hadn't said otherwise I would have thought that it *was* exposed!  The only issue with it really is that it will be slow for certain specialized uses (eg, when one of the matrices is large, sparse and constant, like with CAR models).  I'm also not sure if we have the regular parameterization available.  I know I implemented a matrix_normal_prec version which took precision matrices, but I don't recall implementing the base matrix_normal.  Of course, my memory isn't what it used to be these days...

Cheers,
Marcus
On Tue, Mar 3, 2015 at 10:28 AM Ben Goodrich <goodri...@gmail.com> wrote:

@Marcus: We were talking at the meeting today about the matrix_normal() function, which is apparently not exposed to the Stan language. Did you have a reason why you only wanted that to be used internally?

Ben
